facts.fact: Weaver 宣布 Rookery 窝藏绑架者，指的正是 Mender 与他带走的妹妹 Mae。
facts.anchor: “You’re harboring a kidnapper and the child he stole from her mother.

facts.fact: Mender 当众认下 Mae 是妹妹，说她不愿意跟母亲同住。
Mender 说家里不安全、他们一直在伤害 Mae，Weaver 随即下令直接把人抢走。
facts.anchor: “She’s not safe at home,” the Mender snaps

facts.fact: Mender 伸手去够 Dauntless 腿上的枪，Tris 一掌按下他的肘，喊「Don’t」。
facts.anchor: slamming my hand down on his elbow to knock him back

facts.fact: Evelyn 从楼梯上下来喝止，无派系者停手，Dauntless 也跟着停住。
Evelyn 自称是这里最年长的人、愿意当发言人，用「听证」把突袭拖回程序。
事后 Jove 决定全屋搬走，去 Museum 暂住，等找到新的安全屋。
facts.anchor: “Everyone pack up your things,” Jove says

facts.fact: Evelyn 请 Tris 去跟她母亲谈这场监护听证，Tris 没有迟疑就答应。
facts.anchor: Custody hearings are always conducted with a council member present
